datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 3.6 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 43% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 8% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were collected through OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and supplemented with AI-mapped estimates. The dataset contains approximately 3.6 million buildings with an average data age of 3 years, exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, Geopackage) for accessibility.
